title: Mixed Event — The Tomorrow We Hope For

meta.Outline: When Haruka stops by the shrine along her usual running route, she sees the shrine maiden who was there for her in her time of need collapse. In order to repay her for her kindness, Haruka decides to help out at the shrine in her stead.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Great.
It's a little chilly this morning, but it's really nice out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff... Huff...
Shrine Grounds

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew... That felt good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'll do some stretches as usual here before heading back.)

Hello there, Haruka.
As energetic as ever I see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, Ms. Enomoto, good morning.
You must be busy as well this time of year being a Shrine Maiden and all.

rows.Speaker: Enomoto
rows.Line:
I could say the same for you.
It's incredible how you go out for a run every morning despite it being so cold out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, I really enjoy exercising like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But it's almost New Year's Eve.
I'm sure you've been getting a lot of people lately.

rows.Speaker: Enomoto
rows.Line: Yes, we have. We run ourselves ragged every year around this time to keep this place going.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I can tell...
But it's been getting very cold at night, so please make sure to keep warm.

rows.Speaker: Enomoto
rows.Line:
Thank you!
As busy as it gets, I actually have a lot of fun seeing all these people stop by to pray and make their wishes.

rows.Speaker: Enomoto
rows.Line: They're all trying to make their futures as bright and prosperous as possible, so I'd like to help them achieve their goals in whatever way I can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so noble of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was the recipient of that support a while back too...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I remember visiting this shrine right after I became the lead for ASRUN...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If I recall correctly, that was also when Ms. Enomoto came to talk to me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And I felt so much better after that little chat.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure there are plenty of people out there who are grateful for the support you're giving them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I wish you the best this year.

rows.Speaker: Enomoto
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Now, if you'll excuse me.
Happy holidays.
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew... Showering right after a run always feels so good.

rows.Line: We'll be discussing plans regarding our New Year's stream later tonight, so I think I'll try coming up with some ideas until...

<Haruka! Airi! Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Would that be alright?
Oh, but it's okay if you can't go!!!!>

rows.Line: <Sure, I should be free to go.>

rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hey, that's great.
Airi and Shizuku can go too.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Minori

*Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Yes, that's alright with me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I can't wait to play.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I actually really like these kinds of games. Let's both give it our best, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course! Idols are all about explosiveness! Nobody can match my reflexes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka's on the other team...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Have fun, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku

rows.Speaker: Airi

rows.Line:
What?!
Did she say, “We”...?! Do you know what this means?! Real-life idols dressed up as shrine maidens!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu, why does Mizuki sound so excited...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because Mizuki likes idols and shrine maidens?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: MMJ dressed up as shrine maidens...! We've gotta see this!! How about it, you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really? All of us...?
I mean, I was sort of thinking about seeing how Airi's doing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Kanade, Mafuyu, what do you two think?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I get that leading with seeing idols dressed as shrine maidens wasn't great, but I do kinda want to visit a shrine together with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's cold, so I'd rather not go outside...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, it's supposed to be warmer than usual that day, so it shouldn't be that bad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. It's been pretty warm all winter, so we'll get an early taste of spring during the holidays. Which is why I'm thinking about going.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
In that case, I might go...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Awesome!!
How about you, Mafuyu? Do you think you can make it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to be with my family during the day...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I always have some free time at night, so I'll ask to see if they'll let me go...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
...!!
Thanks, Mafuyu!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I was wondering why they were all gathered like this...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But I guess there's nothing to be concerned about...)
New Year's Eve - 9:00 pm
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, everything seems to fit.
How about the rest of you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka's dressed up as a shrine maiden...! I... I feel so blessed...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Pull yourself together, Minori!
You're a shrine maiden today, not a fan!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and the more experienced shrine maidens will be teaching us proper etiquette...

rows.Speaker: Veteran Shrine Maiden
rows.Line:
Thank you for being so patient.
We really appreciate you volunteering today in Enomoto's place.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, it's our pleasure. We feel like we owe her at least this, so thank you for having us.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: Veteran Shrine Maiden
rows.Line: Hehe. I was told that you're all very polite, but ladylike may be more fitting. Anyway, shall we start discussing etiquette and what you'll be doing?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, so we welcome all the visitors by saying, “Thank you for visiting”... And when we're selling charms and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, we don't “sell” anything. We “confer” them to others.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Because sharing a bit of the divine with everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. Charms and talismans, as well as divine blessings by extension, can be received at the reception building or “Juyosho”.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so interesting how shrines have their own vocabulary.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And we're supposed to treat money as “offerings”. It might take a while to get used to that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, do you all know what your assignments are...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yup!
I'm helping with Omikuji!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll be at the reception with Minori, but helping with conferring charms and talismans instead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll be helping with the sacred wine and amazake.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, sounds like we're all set.
I'll be helping out as a guide for the visitors, so let me know if anything happens. That way, I'll be able to tell the shrine right away.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, Shizuku, your break starts at 4:00 am. Airi and I will take our break at 5:00 am. Also, it's already pretty cold out, so please make sure to stay warm. I wouldn't want us to come down with anything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right! Hehe...
It's so nice having you as our leader, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What? I'm the leader?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you seem so on top of everything. The other shrine maiden even said that you'd be perfect as a guide and go-between for us. Doesn't that make you our leader by default?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's right!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you...
I promise to do my best as your leader today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thirty minutes until we start.
We should probably head over to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, look...! Some visitors are already waiting in line.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
They're here so early.
Maybe they want to be the first ones who make a wish?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If that's the case, they might be hoping for something really big!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A big wish...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is everything okay, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I spaced out a little while thinking about what happened when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When you were little...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When I initially decided that I wanted to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I came to this shrine fairly often back then hoping that my wish would come true.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I made my decision to become an idol in the third grade and started running every morning.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I came here to wish that I'd become an idol someday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa...! But you're Haruka Kiritani.
Everyone sees you as someone who can do anything all on their own. Not someone who prays for a gift from up above...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I get told that pretty often.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, I knew that I had to put in the effort to actually become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But who you meet or what you do can also turn into lucky opportunities, no...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I realized that I couldn't control any of that, so I started coming here to hope that things would tilt my way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you ended up becoming the lead for a huge idol group...! That's Haruka Kiritani for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So you've had this razor-sharp focus ever since you were little?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I wouldn't go quite that far.
I can think of plenty of times when I was worried about what would happen moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, I couldn't sleep at night after becoming the lead for ASRUN because I became so anxious.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
That's happened to you too, Haruka...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I was worried about whether or not I could fill those shoes and felt all this pressure to perform well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, I decided to come back to this shrine.
se_event_prayer_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It's not working...
Coming here always put me at ease before, but I can't shake these feelings this time...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Our nationwide tour starts next week too... And I'm supposed to start appearing as a regular on that TV show...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Do I really have what it takes to be the lead...?)

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me...
Did you drop this handkerchief by chance?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh...
Yes, that's mine. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I dropped it after washing my hands. This handkerchief means quite a bit to me, so I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'm just glad I could reunite it with its owner.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Again, thank you very much.
Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line: I'm sure your wish will come true...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
It just seemed like you had a lot on your mind while praying just now.

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line: I believe that those who are humble and earnest will be blessed. So please, don't think that you're all alone...

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to pry...
If you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not alone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I got so caught up in trying to meet our fans' expectations...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(But she's right. I'm not alone...
I have ASRUN, and we're all in this together...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden
rows.Line: Y-Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
You were right. I was putting far too much pressure on myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I promise to ask the others for help. I know I need to work with them more now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Also, if possible...
Could you tell me your name?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And that shrine maiden was Ms. Enomoto.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What she said made me see things in a different light. She taught me that I just have to keep doing everything that's in my own power.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's so beautiful....!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So that's what you meant by her “supporting” you. Now I understand.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She really did.
She even mentioned how she enjoys seeing everyone trying to make their futures as bright as possible...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I want to do that too. I want to help everyone out as much as I can today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, why don't we all do that together? Let's do everything we can to make everybody's wishes come true.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I wonder what they'll all be wishing for.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I can't wait to find out!
Why don't we start heading over?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay!
New Year's Eve - 11:30 pm
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We're here♪
Whoa, this place is packed!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah! Wow☆
I just caught a glimpse of a bunch of food stalls too!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Rin, what are you doing?!
You can't just pop out like that!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Ugh. They won't see me as long as I'm in her pocket!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, Rin. We'll try to find a place where you can have a better look, so just bear with us for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something bothering you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, uh... Shizuku sent me a message saying that she's been volunteering as a shrine maiden here sometime tonight...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
S-She is?
Shizuku as a shrine maiden?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, won't this place get swarmed if people find out about that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, she said she has a disguise ready to cover her face. I'm just worried about what would happen if she sees me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Hm? I could've sworn that I heard Shii's voice just now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That voice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Back in line, you guys. Try to blend in...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel like you should at least tell her you're here. Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello, Hoshino, Tenma.
Oh, Hinomori, Mochizuki, you're here as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all for visiting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No way!
You're here too, Haruka?! You look adorable as a shrine maiden!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree! It suits you so well...!
You look like a real shrine maiden...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
Some things came up and we decided to lend this shrine a hand as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I had no idea...!
Does that mean Minori and Momoi are here too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. They should be at reception right now. If you have some time to spare, why not go take a peek?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Airi's here too?!
We've gotta see this...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You really can't get enough of her, can you, Saki? I mean, you just got her autograph the other day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, but I'm a huge fan!
I watched the variety shows she was on all the time when I was in the hospital♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's great to hear.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why not go let them know that you're here? I'm sure they'll be happy to see some familiar faces. Also, Hinomori, Shizuku should be just over there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Also, it's dark out, so please watch your step.
Reception

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's see... Hey, there's Airi!
She's the one selling charms and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm gonna go buy one!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, Saki, don't run like that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, a ceremonial arrow, a traffic-safety charm and a talisman. I believe that's everything...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, that was so fast...!
She's a total pro!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like she knows exactly where everything is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, next up... Oh?
Is that you, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
You remember who I am, Airi?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course!
How can I forget?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh wow...! I don't know what to say...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You went through the trouble of lining up, Saki. Why don't you get something?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
I'll get... A charm for good health!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You got it.
They're pink and really cute, just like you, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And here you are!
One charm for good health filled with some of Airi Momoi's love♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?! Thank you so much!
You're the best, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're welcome. I'd love to stay and chat, but we're pretty busy tonight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you, Momoi.
I hope you'll keep an eye on my sister during the new year as well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
Speaking of which, have you seen Shizuku yet? I'm sure she'll be happy to see you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh... Well, I don't want to be a bother... But I guess I should if you insist...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Good!
And good luck with your band!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We're back!
Airi's seriously the best! I like her even more now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Good for you, Saki.
We still have some time, so why don't we draw some fortunes...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Good idea.
It's probably gonna be really crowded later if we put it off.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay...!!
Let's head over!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't think people usually get this worked up over Omikuji.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's like she's going into battle or something...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It should be... Oh, found it!
Look, Hanasato's behind that counter.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Really?
Why don't we do our drawings there?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, I wanna see what I get!
Can you draw mine for me, Hona?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I'd like to see as well!
How about you, KAITO?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I am a little curious...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, won't it be weird if you drew fortunes for six extra people?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, he's right. Why don't we just have one collective drawing instead? How would you feel about that, Honami?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, you can count on me!
I promise to draw something good this time...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I'm worried about Honami...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So am I...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's see...! #39!
Here's your fortune. Next please.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good evening, Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Honami! What a nice coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, here's the Omikuji tube!
I recommend shaking it a few times before drawing anything out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay... Here goes nothing!
se_event_prayer_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (H-Honami has such a stern look on her face! I don't think I've seen anyone take this so seriously...! Does she have a really big wish or something...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll take this one! Please!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, lemme see!
Uh... #66! That should be right over here!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A-Another “great curse”!! How?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A... A “great curse”?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I knew this would happen...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, she's been jinxing it left and right...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do...?!
I need to cheer Honami up somehow...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Honami!
You'll be rewarded as long as you keep trying your best! I'm sure of it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: H-Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-How about you do another drawing...?! You'd still, unfortunately, have to pay for it, but I'm sure it'll be better than your last one...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's a small price to pay...
Okay, #34!
se_event_prayer_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, here you are!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A-Another “curse”...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, that's a good thing! That means you're improving! I'm sure you'll do even better if you keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, you're absolutely right! Again...!
se_event_prayer_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't think that's how these fortunes work...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I doubt it too...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I did it...! I got a “good blessing”!
Hanasato, I finally got one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
C-Congratulations!!
I knew you'd succeed as long as you kept trying!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Hona's happy, so it's all good♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting!
I finally drew a “good blessing”!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can see that.
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The bell...
It's already past midnight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're right.
When did that happen...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry...
We missed our chance because I got so caught up in drawing a good fortune...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No problemo!
We can just do it now. Ready...?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now then, shall we go make our wishes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm gonna wish for a ton of stuff this year!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe...
Before dawn
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... Things are finally starting to calm down.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Great work so far, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori and Shizuku should be returning from their break soon, so let's take ours once they get back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds good. I just got a new heat pack out, but I still feel pretty chilly. It'll be nice to rest somewhere that's actually warm.
Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Haruka!
Nice shrine maiden outfit! It looks great on you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Haruka!
Let's make this year a good one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
An, Kohane...!
I wasn't expecting to see you two here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori told me about how you'll be volunteering as a shrine maiden here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still can't believe that An's best friends with Haruka Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, but is it really that strange...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, she's someone you're supposed to see on TV and stuff instead of real life, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh?
Akito? Toya? You two are here too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? Momoi?
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Can't you tell? I'm a shrine maiden!
We've decided to help out by volunteering as a group.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
As a group, huh...?
Hm? That means Hanasato's here too, right...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you know Minori?
But you're spot on. She, Haruka, Shizuku and I are all in a group called MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, An, I heard that you and your team gave Minori some pointers for singing at the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did!
Akito and Toya taught her a bunch of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I didn't know that.
Thanks a bunch, you two!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'd like to thank you both as well.
Minori said your advice helped quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
It was nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, teaching someone how to sing like that turned into a nice learning opportunity for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You guys sound just as passionate as An when it comes to singing. It's no wonder you're on the same team.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By the way, where's Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's taking a break right now, but she should be back soon. Why don't you head over to the Omikuji booth later to let her know that you're here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, I will!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But first, let's go make our wishes!
se_event_prayer_2022_006

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, it's our turn!
You guys know what you're wishing for?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sure we'll all be wishing for the same thing... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I wanna make a wish too!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Me too!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, hold up. You guys can look around and stuff, but don't jump out like that. What if someone sees you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Would it be alright if I made a wish as well...?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku!
Would you like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I think we all should since we're here.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, we're up next!
Ready, everyone?!
se_event_prayer_2022_006
se_event_prayer_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to do everything I can to surpass RAD WEEKEND. Please keep watching over all of us...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(They all look so serious...
I'm guessing their wish has to do with that one event.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good luck, you guys...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, our year's officially started!
We just need to see Minori and it'll be mission accomplished!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why don't we stop and take a break around here? Hm...? Looks like they're handing out amazake.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Doesn't amazake have alcohol in it?
Is it okay for us to drink that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Some types of amazake are made like regular sake using sake yeast, while others are made from the remnants of the sake-making process.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The type of amazake that's handed out at shrines usually doesn't have any alcohol in it, so we should be fine.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Way to go, Toya! I never knew that!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I read it in a book.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sake, huh...?
That reminds me of the time MEIKO recommended whiskey to me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Is that true, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You didn't offer alcohol to a minor, did you?!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Wait, is that true?
What kind of person are you?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! KAITO?! Luka?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You're both getting the wrong idea. I didn't offer anything to him. That was entirely a story of “what if...?”>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So... Have anything to say, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A minor drinking alcohol is a very serious crime...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I didn't drink anything!
It turned out to be oolong tea!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, breaktime's over.
Time to get back to work!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Minori's back from her break!
She's supposed to be over at the Omikuji booth, so why don't we all head over there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hi, Kohane!
I didn't know you were coming!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: With all of Vivid BAD SQUAD too...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hi, Minori!
It's pretty chilly out. I hope your shrine maiden outfit's keeping you warm.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It is! I even have hand warmers and heat packs to go along with it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, how does a fortune drawing sound? It's calmed down quite a bit, so now's your best chance!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Fortunes as in Omikuji...?
Sure, why not?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, it'll be a good test of luck.
I'll give it a go too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Great! We'll go one at a time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ready, guys?
We'll open them on three, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: One, two...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yay! A “great blessing”!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really? That's great, An!
Mine was a “blessing”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I got a “good blessing”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmm... Mine's a “minor blessing”...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A “blessing” and “minor blessing” aren't that different, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be fair, most hierarchies naturally place “blessings” over “minor blessing”.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you can always draw another one if you're not happy with what you got!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Does anyone actually fall for that...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. These always have such interesting suggestions written in them too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, like this one... “Follow your heart...”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Follow your heart”...? So it's telling you to just do as you feel? That's pretty cool. It suits you perfectly, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Follow your heart, huh...?
Alright, how does practice sound after this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Interesting.
I was just thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha! So much for our day off!
We'd be back on schedule sooner than expected...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At the same time, I guess that's sort of how we are!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's make this year a good one, you guys!
Shrine Grounds

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Mommy, I'm scared!
There's a weird monster running around!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Wait, isn't that the thing that bites people's heads?!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...
se_event_prayer_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: The children seem scared of Lion Dance Robot.

rows.Line: Unfortunately, it's natural for children to be scared since he looks like the actual thing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wouldn't want to traumatize any of them, so I may have to have him wait here with you, Robo-Nene. We'll find a better role for him in one of our shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's too bad...
Sorry, Lion Dance Robot, you're gonna have to wait here!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You seriously thought you could take him with you to the shrine...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, this is his time of year to shine... But we wouldn't want to cause a stir, so he'll just have to sit out this one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, let's head in!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, that's it for my second break.
I should be able to make it through to the evening now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm...? A dancing lion...?
What's it doing over there...?
Shrine Hall
se_event_prayer_2022_006
se_event_prayer_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's make lots and lots of people around the world smile!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Lots and lots and lots!>

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, lots and lots!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Aren't you supposed to say these kinds of wishes quietly? I guess it's too late now...
se_event_prayer_2022_006
se_event_prayer_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My shows are going to make the entire world smile ear to ear!!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That sounds more like a declaration than a wish.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha... I'd expect nothing less from Tsukasa.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Luka, wake up!
You still need to make your wish!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Mhm... But I'm so full...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <No, not that! Your New Year's wish!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright, we all made our wishes!
Next, we can do... Omikuji!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, a test of luck to start off the year! Sounds good! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah, let's go♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, wait!
It's not safe to run!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh dear... I'm seeing quite a few people. Are you sure they won't see us? I feel like we should stay hidden for this part.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree... Would you mind remaining on standby for now? Oh, why don't we draw some fortunes for you in your place?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Ah, that would be perfect!
Thank you, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're very welcome.
It's the least we can do for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, would you kindly draw fortunes for the others in their stead?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
For all of them? Okay, got it!
Including me that's... Seven!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I got a “great blessing”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I got another one!
And another!! And another!! Wow, this one's a “great blessing” too!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-How can anyone be this lucky...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Seven “great blessings” in a row. What are the odds? At this point, it may be better for Emu to draw our fortunes for us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That'd completely defeat the purpose of coming here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
All “great blessings”!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's unbelievable, Emu...!
Please try to share some of your luck with Honami if you can...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, that's a “great blessing” for all of you... That just leaves...
Huh? Tsukasa, is that you...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
Well, hello!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?! Was someone yelling just now...? Wait, what if it's an accident...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's wonderful to see you, Shizuku!
How long has it been?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I thought it was you, Tsukasa!
It's been quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh wow! She's so pretty!
Do you know her, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, her name is Shizuku! She's Shiho's big sister, and we used to play at the park together when we were little!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?! Shiho has a big sister?!
I'm Emu Otori! It's super nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you know Shii?
It's a pleasure to meet you. It's so nice to meet another one of her friends.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Shizuku...!
Wait, that voice... Huh? Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Haruka!
You're dressed as a shrine maiden too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, Haruka...? As in Haruka Kiritani...? Sure, she looks a lot like her, but there's no way the real deal would be running around as a shrine maiden like this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello to you too.
I heard someone yelling just now. Did something happen? Was there an accident...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was Tsukasa hitting a zillion decibels on the meter!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, you could at least use a real number, you know?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I see... I'm glad as long as it's nothing serious. Thank you for letting me know, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hold on... Are these the friends you've been telling me about? The ones from the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We all work super duper hard to make everyone smile♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, where are my manners...
Happy New Year. My name is Haruka Kiritani. I go to the same school as Otori.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-It's really her...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...
And the two with you are...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We met on that mountain sometime back. It's nice to see you again like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Kusanagi and Kamishiro, yes?
I can't thank you enough for what you did for us then!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Hold on...
You already know each other?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We do! They were there to save us when my friends and I got lost during our picnic.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that's right...! I remember hearing a story like that when we were chatting at the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means you're both friends of Tsukasa's friend!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, we only met that one time. Also, I never would've expected to run into someone like Shizuku Hinomori while out hiking...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But that's great to hear...
Thank you for helping Shizuku out that time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You're welcome but... W-We really didn't do that much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Reality is stranger than fiction, no? Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Waaah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! I hear a little girl crying! I think she just tripped and fell down the stairs!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's awful...!
We need to help them...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, would you mind leaving this to us...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Cheering up a crying child during New Year's is sort of our department, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you definitely have a point...!
Thankfully, she doesn't appear to be hurt. I believe we can take it from here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-Hey, wait!
E-Excuse us, Hinomori... A-And Kiritani...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. There they go...
Tsukasa's friends seem like such wonderful people.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Shrine Grounds

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Waaah!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: There, there. That must've hurt so much... She won't stop crying... What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Wh-What's that...?!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I-Is that a dancing lion...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “A long, long time ago, a certain shrine was the home of a Lion Dance Robot!”

rows.Speaker: Shrine Visitors
rows.Line:
Hm? What's going on?
And what's a Lion Dance Robot?

rows.Speaker: Shrine Visitors
rows.Line: Is a show about to start?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “He loved children very much and wanted to make them smile, but they were all afraid of the way he looked and would run away every time he tried to go near them.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I heard that this dancing lion eats people!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “What?! Everybody, run!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...
se_event_prayer_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “However, somebody up above saw Lion Dance Robot's plight and decided to call out to him!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Hah hah hah! Chin up, my friend! I shall bestow upon you the power to make others smile and laugh!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Behold the power of the divine! Accept my gift!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP...!!

rows.Line:
Look, mochi!
Mommy, the lion's giving us mochi!

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's not all Lion Dance Robot Beta can do. By attaching a kite to its head...

rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad everything worked out.
But the shrine might not be happy with us if we keep making such a big fuss...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A show at a shrine...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
I remember hearing some people wishing to be able to make everybody smile.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That must've been Otori and her friends...
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow... I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So am I. I'm guessing it has to do with having to stand the entire time outside of breaks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hate to break it to you both, but we still have a stream to do tomorrow. Try to hang in there, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You don't seem tired one bit, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I know...! What if we did our stream dressed as shrine maidens?! I bet everybody will love it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nice idea, but something doesn't seem right about borrowing these for that sort of purpose... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No way! You guys really are dressed as shrine maidens! Cute doesn't even begin to describe how you look!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:

Not, “Happy New Year”...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena! Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:

Let's make this year a good one.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Hinomori.
Ena told us that you'd all be here, but I still quite can't believe that you're here volunteering as shrine maidens.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, some things came up and we all decided to help out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I see. You must've been very busy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: S-S-So cold...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, are you alright?
It's been warmer than usual around this time, but it still gets pretty chilly after the sun goes down...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That reminds me. How does some amazake sound? That should warm you right up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that sounds great!
We might just have to take you up on that♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright, here you are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...
Ahh, so warm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! Amazake from a real idol!
I can feel it coursing through my veins! It's like all five of my senses are on fire now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You sound like an old man after a night of drinking...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
This is just what we needed.
Thank you, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're all very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've warmed up, let's start hitting up everything we can here!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Such as...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For starters, Omikuji!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Aren't we usually supposed to make our wishes first?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aww, don't be like that!
We'll be fine as long as we keep believing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to feel about that, but I don't see a problem with checking out everything in whatever order you like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I agree...
There's no rule saying that we have to go in a certain order.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess that's true.
Plus, I got to see Airi. Let's get this over with so we can head over to a diner to relax.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, I can show you where the Omikuji booth is. Shall we?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yay! I got a “great blessing”♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why'd it give me a "curse"...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, I've never seen anyone get that before! Wanna trade?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't need your pity!

rows.Line: Let's see... Kanade, you got #99!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you...
Oh...

rows.Line: Can I try again?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Of course!
Is it for someone else?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes...
Well... For all the others...
se_event_prayer_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright...!
Here you are! #1!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What did you get, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A “minor blessing”. How about you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I got the same.
I think it's because we both drew the same number.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right.
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It says, “Work hard and your wish will be granted...”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...
By working hard...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's do our best this year, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, let's...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey!
Looks like there's no line for the shrine! We can make our wishes right now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Be right there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Yoisaki's group may very well be the last we see making wishes tonight.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, everyone got their offerings ready? We can ring the bell once we throw them in...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'm ready...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here we go!

se_event_prayer_2022_005

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to draw in a way that I can be happy with this year... And...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I'll do something about Mizuki myself... I can't wish that away after saying that I'd wait...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm glad we're celebrating New Year's like this again...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Please make it so things stay like this...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I want to discover the “real me”...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to compose a song that can save everyone...)

rows.Line: (I came to take a quick peek...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But they seem completely focused on their wishes.)

rows.Line: <I'll make a wish too...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Please make all of their wishes come true...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Line: (I thought I saw something poke out of Yoisaki's pocket just now... Maybe I'm just seeing things...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Everything alright, Haruka?
Is something going on with Ena and her friends?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Uh... No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was just marveling at how seriously they're taking their wishes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I noticed that too.
What they're all wishing for must be very important to them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally understand! It's natural to take a little longer when wishing for something really big or important!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, let's...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't actually know what they're wishing for...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I hope all of their wishes come true for them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And... That's a wrap.
Thank you all for doing this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That just flew by us, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. It was nice seeing how everyone smiled as we distributed amazake to them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It wasn't always easy, but it ended up being really fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Also, it was great seeing so many people stop by to make their wishes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. It sure was!

rows.Speaker: Airi
